arena.name: Treasure Island
arena.subtitle: Find the hidden places of the island

location.name: Old Lighthouse
location.clue: A tall tower that guides ships at night.

location.name: Airship Hangar
location.clue: A giant shed where flying ships are kept.

location.name: Central Plaza
location.clue: The paved square in the middle of the island.

location.name: Harbor Cranes
location.clue: Tall machines that lift heavy boxes from ships.

location.name: Fire Volcano
location.clue: A mountain that glows with hot red rivers.

location.name: Twin Domes
location.clue: Two glass half-balls where plants grow under cover.

location.name: Jungle Temple
location.clue: Old stone ruins hidden deep in the trees.

location.name: Island Airstrip
location.clue: A long flat strip where small planes land.

location.name: Fish Farm
location.clue: Blue pools where fish are raised for the village.

location.name: Desert Oasis
location.clue: A pool of water surrounded by palms in the sand.

location.name: Palm Grove
location.clue: A shady patch of palm trees near the plaza.

location.name: Refinery
location.clue: Pipes and tall chimneys that smoke all day.
